title: Getting started with tinytrail
text: Place two calls every script trail stays current automatically. Call tinytrail() top script short description script : wrap file path argument save call tinytrail_write(). logs path returns unchanged, slots directly file = argument write function: works equally well ::(): Optionally, put tinytrail_the_end() end script. records time tinytrail() marker script_runtime, handy scripts take long time run. run code line line, time may reliable. need add. trail file (_tinytrail.yaml) created project root first run updated every subsequent run:
code: library(tinytrail)  # --- top of 01_clean.R --- tinytrail(   description = "Clean and reshape survey data",   data_source = "Current Population Survey (BLS)" ) write.csv(   survey,   file = tinytrail_write("data/clean/survey_clean.csv") ) write.csv(   survey,   file = tinytrail_write(here::here("data/clean/survey_clean.csv")) ) # --- end of 01_clean.R --- tinytrail_the_end() $version: 0.1.0 $learn_more: https://github.com/tinytrail-r/tinytrail scripts:   01_clean.R:     description: Clean and reshape survey data     data_source: Current Population Survey (BLS)     first_run: '2026-01-15 09:12'     latest_run: '2026-01-20 11:05'     script_runtime: 0.3 min     n_outputs: 1     outputs:     - data/clean/survey_clean.csv   02_model.R:     description: Fit logistic regression     data_source: Cleaned survey data (01_clean.R)     first_run: '2026-01-16 14:22'     latest_run: '2026-01-20 11:08'     script_runtime: 1.4 min     n_outputs: 2     outputs:     - results/model_fit.rds     - results/table_coefficients.csv

title: Getting started with tinytrail
text: tinytrail_dict() optional third function. Place end read clean pipeline capture column names sample values input data frame: entry stored calling script trail file: omit sample values record column names, use sample_values = FALSE:
code: survey <- read.csv("data/raw/survey.csv") |>   tinytrail_dict() data_dictionary:   01_clean.R:     survey:       columns:         id: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]         age: [34, 52, 28, 41, 37]         response: ['yes', 'no', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'] survey <- read.csv("data/raw/survey.csv") |>   tinytrail_dict(sample_values = FALSE)

code: install.packages("tinytrail")  # Development version from GitHub: pak::pak("tinytrail-r/tinytrail")

title: Lightweight Auto-Updating Project Tracker and Data Dictionary
text: Call tinytrail() near top script. Common write functions intercepted automatically: tinytrail() detects script name creates updates _tinytrail.yaml: Optionally, pipe data frames tinytrail_dict() capture column names sample values: adds data dictionary entry _tinytrail.yaml:
code: library(tinytrail)  tinytrail(   description = "Clean and summarise survey data",   data_source = "Current Population Survey (BLS)" )  dat <- read.csv("data/raw/survey.csv")  write.csv(dat, "output/clean.csv")   # auto-tracked  png("output/age_dist.png")           # auto-tracked hist(dat$age, main = "Age distribution") dev.off()  tinytrail_the_end()                  # optional: records script_runtime scripts:   01_clean.R:     description: Clean and summarise survey data     data_source: Current Population Survey (BLS)     first_run: '2026-06-27 09:00'     latest_run: '2026-06-27 09:01'     script_runtime: 0.2 min     n_outputs: 2     outputs:     - output/age_dist.png     - output/clean.csv # ... cleaning and preparing data ...  dat |>   tinytrail_dict() data_dictionary:   01_clean.R:     dat:       columns:         id: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]         age: [34, 52, 28, 41, 37]         response: ['yes', 'no', 'yes', 'yes', 'no']

title: Lightweight Auto-Updating Project Tracker and Data Dictionary
text: write functions built-list, pass list extra_hooks function names file-path arguments: (two functions already captured automatically — ’re shown illustration .) use package whose save write functions tinytrail doesn’t track yet, please open issue name package function. ’ll see can soon possible.
code: tinytrail(   description = "Export results",   extra_hooks = list(     fn  = c("readr::write_csv", "ggplot2::ggsave"),     arg = c("file",             "filename")   ) )

title: Lightweight Auto-Updating Project Tracker and Data Dictionary
text: track specific outputs, set auto = FALSE use tinytrail_write() explicitly. returns argument invisibly, drops inline save call:
code: tinytrail("Export selected results", auto = FALSE)  write.csv(dat, tinytrail_write("output/clean.csv")) saveRDS(model, tinytrail_write(here::here("output/model.rds")))

title: Register a script in the project trail — tinytrail
code: tinytrail(   description,   data_source = NULL,   pin_to_top = FALSE,   record_runtime = NULL,   name = NULL,   auto = TRUE,   extra_hooks = NULL )

title: Register a script in the project trail — tinytrail
text: description Character. Description script . data_source Character. Optional. Enter sources data used script — name dataset survey, file path (e.g. "Current Population Survey (BLS)"). pin_to_top Logical. Pin script top trail. Useful main.R sources scripts — keeps visible top _tinytrail.yaml regardless alphabetical order. Default FALSE. record_runtime Deprecated ignored. record long script takes, put tinytrail_the_end() end script. name Character. Override auto-detected script name. Intended use tests non-standard execution environments auto-detection unavailable. auto Logical. Automatically intercept common write functions record output paths. Default TRUE. Set FALSE use explicit tinytrail_write() calls instead. extra_hooks list elements fn arg specifying additional write functions intercept auto = TRUE. fn character vector function names ("my_save" script-level function, "pkg::fn" package function). arg character vector corresponding file-path argument names. Functions packages installed silently skipped.

title: Register a script in the project trail — tinytrail
text: name (script name), invisibly. Called side effect creating updating YAML trail file project root.

title: Register a script in the project trail — tinytrail
text: default (auto = TRUE) common write functions (write.csv, saveRDS, readr::write_csv, ggplot2::ggsave, etc.) hooked automatically output file paths captured without tinytrail_write() wrapper. Set auto = FALSE use explicit tinytrail_write() calls instead.

title: Add a data frame to the project data dictionary — tinytrail_dict
text: df data frame. df_name Character. Label entry data dictionary. Defaults variable name df written calling code (e.g. mtcars |> tinytrail_dict() records "mtcars"). Override expression simple name need custom label. sample_values Logical. Record 5 sample values per column. Default TRUE. sample_string_length Integer Inf. Maximum characters per sample value truncating "...". Default 18L.

title: tinytrail 0.2.0
text: New tinytrail_the_end(): put end script record time since tinytrail() script_runtime (#12).

title: tinytrail 0.2.0
text: record_runtime argument tinytrail() deprecated ignored (gives warning set). tinytrail() longer tries detect script ends, longer prints “runtime tracking requires source() …” (#12).

title: tinytrail 0.2.0
text: tinytrail_write() automatic hooks now record outputs written inside anonymous functions, lapply()/vapply() Quarto chunks, instead failing “values must length 1” (#9). Automatic recording now records files saved user’s code. Writes made RStudio, knitr, rmarkdown, evaluate Quarto (chunk figures, cache, plot previews) files R’s session temp folder skipped (#9). Rendering Quarto (report.rmarkdown) rendering plain script (script.spin.Rmd) now records source file name (report.qmd, script.R), render interactive run update entry instead creating duplicates (#13).

title: tinytrail 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-04 Initial release (renamed tinylog). tinytrail() registers script project YAML trail optionally records elapsed runtime. tinytrail_write() wraps save call log output file path calling script’s trail entry. tinytrail_dict() captures column names sample values input data frames.
